source: artifacts/research/concepts.md §6 (defects in the art, do not copy). A checklist item whose text matches a pattern copies the defect and fails `bar:lint-checklists`. Patterns are case-insensitive JavaScript regexes.

defects.defect: The altitude curve is a symmetric parabola; real descent under a parachute is slower and longer.
Burnout is shown at about 20 s, but the thrust curve on page 03 burns 2.5 s.
The inset arcs are symmetric ballistic shapes.
The tree says Fins (3), while 02 has Fin count 4 and 4 rendered fins.
The tree rows differ between pages (Fin can + Fins (3) vs Fin set).
The history shows step 02 twice (Assembly layout and Fin revision).
The selected-fin teal fill sits on the upper fin only.
The dorsal fin is larger than the ventral one, which is not plausible for a fin set.
The history appears both in the agent pane and in the bottom strip with different contents. Choose one owner.
defects.pattern: \bdesign history\b.{0,40}\b(?:in|inside) the agent pane|\bagent pane\b.{0,40}\bdesign history\b|\bdifferent (?:contents|steps)\b

defects.defect: The left rail drops the Components tree and adds analyses with no defined pages.
